ops.text: The Company may assign this Agreement without consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets. HDI may not assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the Company (which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld), and in no event to a competitor of the Company. No change of control of the Company shall give HDI any right to terminate this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 only binds successors and assigns and leaves transfers wholly unrestricted, so HDI could assign this hosting engagement to anyone, including a competitor of ours, without our consent. We have added a short sentence set confirming our affiliate/successor assignment right, a reasonableness-qualified consent gate and competitor bar on HDI assignments, and that a change of control of the Company gives HDI no termination right; the existing sentence is untouched.
proposal.summary: Insert concise assignment terms after Section 10.3: Company affiliate/successor assignment without consent, consent gate plus competitor bar on HDI assignment, and no HDI termination right on a Company change of control.
